raw_quote: Tata Capital Personal Loan for multipurpose domestic and personal financing.
Unsecured retail personal loan.
No collateral, guarantor or security required.
Applicant must be an Indian citizen.
Typically applicants must be between 21 and 58 years of age.
Upper age at loan maturity is 58 years for salaried individuals.
Salaried employees of private companies, MNCs, public limited firms, and Govt organizations.
A stable employment history of at least one year is generally expected.
A minimum monthly income is required, commonly cited as Rs 15,000 to Rs 20,000.
Minimum bureau cutoff benchmark of 675 points (score of 750+ preferred for best pricing).
Scores 750+ qualify for lowest starting APR band.
The amount you can borrow is often determined by a multiplier of your monthly salary (e.g., up to 30 times).
Personal loan quantum extends up to Rs. 35.00 Lakhs.
Minimum loan ticket size: Rs. 40,000.
Fixed obligation to income ratio (FOIR) capped at 50% to 55% of net monthly income.
Minimum repayment period: 12 months.
Repayment tenure extending up to 72 months (6 years).
Starting interest rate from 10.99% p.a.
Upper ceiling interest rate up to 26.00% p.a.
Processing fee: Up to 2.75% of the loan amount (min Rs. 1,499 + GST).
Foreclosure charges of 2% to 4.5% + GST depending on tenure completed.
Approval and final terms are at the sole discretion of Tata Capital Financial Services Ltd.
